title: Uvavanyo Lwesidalwa Esingcwele
intro: Kwathunyelwa uphawu kwisizwe esasiphambukile. Phakathi kobomi babo obutofotofo kwafika isilumkiso—sihamba nesidalwa esimangalisayo esasiza kuba luvavanyo lokugqibela lokholo lwabo. Impendulo yabo yayiza kuqinisekisa ikamva labo ngonaphakade. Ungafumanisa ukuba ngubani owenze esi silumkiso kwaye kwenzeka ntoni kwabo basichasayo?
clues: Sasingabantu ababekhokelwa ngabathunywa bangaphambili ngaphambi kwethu.
Isidalwa esimangalisayo savela entabeni, umqondiso ovela eNkosini yethu kolu hlanga.
Ndathi kubo: 'Le yinkamela yemazi ka-Allah, ngoko ke yiyekeni itye emhlabeni ka-Allah kwaye ningayichukumisi ngomonakalo.'
Kodwa abantu bayinqumle imisipha inkamela yam, bewuchasa umyalelo weNkosi yabo.
Ndingumthunywa ovela eNkosini yakho, ndithunywe ngenyaniso—ndingumprofeti nomkhonzi othembekileyo.
Abenzi bobubi, iNkosi yethu yababetha ngesandi esikhulu, baza banganyakazi emakhayeni abo.

arabic: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ فَكَانُوا۟ كَهَشِيمِ ٱلْمُحْتَظِرِ
verse: Indeed, We sent upon them one shriek [i.e., blast from the sky], and they became like the dry twig fragments of an [animal] pen. (54:31)
